tagline.en: Mobile Bay to Lake Michigan, four states, no detours
tagline.zh: 从莫比尔湾到密歇根湖，纵贯四州，一线到底

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 亚拉巴马州莫比尔，与 I-10 相接

end.en: US 12 and US 20 in Gary, Indiana
end.zh: 印第安纳州加里，与 US 12、US 20 相接

en: I-65 is one of the simplest long Interstates to describe: it starts a few miles from the Gulf of Mexico and runs north, without ever sharing its number with another Interstate for more than a few miles, until it reaches the industrial south shore of Lake Michigan. Four states, four state capitals or near-misses, and a steady change of climate along the way.

The southern end crosses the Mobile–Tensaw River Delta on an elevated causeway and a pair of tall steel arches over the Mobile River, then climbs gently through the pine country of south Alabama to Montgomery and Birmingham. North of Birmingham it threads the last hills of the Appalachian plateau, drops into the Tennessee Valley at Nashville, crosses the Kentucky karst past Mammoth Cave, and spends its last two hundred miles on the flat till plain of central Indiana.
Alabama uses the road as a hurricane evacuation route: in an emergency all lanes between Mobile and Montgomery can be run northbound.
zh: I-65 是最容易一句话说清的长距离州际公路之一：它起于距墨西哥湾数英里之处一路北行，除极短路段外从不与其他州际公路共用编号，直抵密歇根湖南岸的工业地带。四个州，几处州府或擦身而过的州府，沿途气候持续变化。
南端以高架堤道跨越莫比尔—坦索河三角洲，并借一对高耸的钢拱桥跨过莫比尔河，随后在亚拉巴马南部的松林间缓缓爬升，经蒙哥马利抵伯明翰。伯明翰以北，它穿过阿巴拉契亚高原最后的丘陵，在纳什维尔下切入田纳西河谷，越过肯塔基的喀斯特地貌、途经猛犸洞，最后两百英里则行驶在印第安纳中部平坦的冰碛平原上。
亚拉巴马把这条路用作飓风疏散通道：紧急状况下，莫比尔至蒙哥马利之间的全部车道都可改为北向通行。

en: Parts of I-65 predate the Interstate System. The Kentucky Turnpike between Louisville and Elizabethtown opened as a toll road in 1956 and was later absorbed; Tennessee's first project built under the 1956 act was a short stretch of what became I-65, and Alabama's first Interstate opening was likewise a piece of I-65 north of Birmingham.

Kentucky was the first of the four states to finish its share, the last gap near Franklin opening in June 1970. Its turnpike stayed tolled until the construction bonds were paid off; state law forbids extending tolls once that happens, so the booths came down in 1975 and the Kentucky Turnpike name disappeared with them. Indiana's last urban gap, through downtown Indianapolis, closed in the mid-1970s.

Alabama came last, and by a wide margin. Two of the final links anywhere in the Interstate System were on I-65: the delta crossing north of Mobile, whose first construction contracts were awarded in 1967 and which did not open until October 1981, and a 14-mile section between Lewisburg and Warrior north of Birmingham that replaced a four-lane stretch of US 31 signed as I-65 but never built to standard. It opened in December 1985, completing the route.
zh: I-65 的部分路段早于州际公路系统。路易斯维尔至伊丽莎白敦的肯塔基收费公路 1956 年作为收费道路通车，后来被并入；田纳西依 1956 年法案兴建的第一个项目，是后来成为 I-65 的一小段；亚拉巴马第一条通车的州际公路同样是伯明翰以北的一段 I-65。
肯塔基是全美第一个建成本州全部州际公路配额的州，I-65 是其中一环。印第安纳最后一处城市缺口——印第安纳波利斯市中心段——在 1970 年代中期补齐。
亚拉巴马落在最后，而且差距很大。整个州际公路系统最晚完成的路段中有两处在 I-65 上：莫比尔以北的三角洲跨越工程，首批施工合同 1967 年发出，直到 1981 年 10 月才通车；以及伯明翰以北刘易斯堡至沃里尔之间 14 英里路段，用以取代一段挂着 I-65 标牌、却从未按标准建设的四车道 US 31。该段于 1985 年 12 月通车，全线告成。

en: The delta crossing at the southern end was, when it opened, the most expensive highway project Alabama had ever undertaken — a six-mile structure, most of it low concrete viaduct on piles across open swamp, rising to twin tied steel arches with high clearance over the Mobile River shipping channel so that the crossing would not obstruct the port.

The figure usually quoted for it circulates through secondary road references rather than any published Alabama Department of Transportation record, so it is not reproduced here as a verified number. The same is true of the route as a whole: four states built I-65 over three decades with federal aid accounted for by state and fiscal year, and no route total was ever compiled.
The road's more recent costs are easier to trace than its construction costs, because widening and reconstruction projects are let and reported individually by each state.
zh: 南端的三角洲跨越工程在通车时是亚拉巴马有史以来造价最高的公路项目——全长六英里，大部分是打桩架设、横穿开阔沼泽的低矮混凝土高架，并在莫比尔河航道上方升起一对系杆钢拱，净空很高，以免妨碍港口通航。
通常被引用的造价数字只在二手道路资料中流传，并无亚拉巴马州交通部公开记录可循，因此本文不把它当作已核实的数字列出。整条路线也是如此：四个州历时三十年建成 I-65，联邦补助按州和财政年度核算，从未汇总出全线总额。
这条路近年的花费比当年的造价更容易追查，因为拓宽和改建项目由各州分别招标并分别公布。

why.en: No public figure exists. Alabama, Tennessee, Kentucky and Indiana built the route between the late 1950s and 1985, one section was an existing state toll road absorbed into the system, and federal aid was accounted for by state and fiscal year rather than by route.
why.zh: 无公开数据。亚拉巴马、田纳西、肯塔基和印第安纳自 1950 年代末至 1985 年间分别建成本路线，其中一段是被并入系统的既有州属收费公路；联邦补助按州和财政年度而非按路线核算。

value.en: 884.97 miles across 4 states; longest in Alabama at 366.09 miles, shortest in Tennessee at 120.13
value.zh: 884.97 英里，横跨 4 个州；亚拉巴马州最长，366.09 英里；田纳西州最短，120.13 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

label.zh: 莫比尔—坦索三角洲跨越工程造价

why.en: Secondary road references put the 1981 delta crossing at roughly $136–137 million and describe it as the most expensive highway project in Alabama's history to that date, but the figure traces back only to contemporary newspaper reporting that could not be inspected directly, and no Alabama Department of Transportation record of it is published.
why.zh: 二手道路资料把 1981 年建成的三角洲跨越工程造价列为约 1.36 至 1.37 亿美元，并称其为亚拉巴马当时史上造价最高的公路项目，但该数字只能追溯到无法直接查阅的当年报纸报道，亚拉巴马州交通部亦未公布相关记录。

why.en: No agency publishes a route-wide figure. Counts are collected per segment by the four state transportation departments on different schedules, and volumes on I-65 range from rural two-lane-per-direction stretches in south Alabama to urban sections in Nashville, Louisville and Indianapolis that are not comparable.
why.zh: 没有机构发布全线数字。交通量由四个州的交通部门按各自的周期分段采集；I-65 的流量从亚拉巴马南部单向双车道的乡村路段，到纳什维尔、路易斯维尔、印第安纳波利斯的城市路段，彼此并不可比。

timeline.en: The Kentucky Turnpike opens on 1 August between Louisville and Elizabethtown as a bond-financed toll road; it is later absorbed into I-65.
timeline.zh: 8 月 1 日，以债券融资的肯塔基收费公路在路易斯维尔与伊丽莎白敦之间通车，后被并入 I-65。

timeline.en: Alabama awards the first construction contracts for the 12-mile crossing of the Mobile–Tensaw River Delta.
timeline.zh: 亚拉巴马发出横跨莫比尔—坦索河三角洲 12 英里路段的首批施工合同。

timeline.en: Kentucky becomes the first state to complete its portion of I-65 when the last gap near Franklin opens on 22 June.
timeline.zh: 6 月 22 日，富兰克林附近最后一处缺口通车，肯塔基成为第一个建成本州 I-65 路段的州。

timeline.en: Tolls come off the Kentucky Turnpike on 30 June, nineteen years ahead of schedule, and the turnpike signs are removed with the booths.
timeline.zh: 6 月 30 日，肯塔基收费公路停止收费，比原定计划提早十九年；收费亭拆除的同时，收费公路标牌也一并撤下。

timeline.en: The delta crossing and the General W.K. Wilson Jr. Bridge over the Mobile River open to traffic on 2 October, fourteen years after the first contracts.
timeline.zh: 10 月 2 日，三角洲跨越段及跨越莫比尔河的小威尔逊将军大桥通车，距首批合同已过十四年。

timeline.en: The final section, 14 miles between Lewisburg and Warrior in Alabama, opens on 19 December, completing I-65 end to end.
timeline.zh: 12 月 19 日，亚拉巴马刘易斯堡至沃里尔之间 14 英里的最后一段通车，I-65 全线贯通。
